purpose: Human-service market reference for bounded CSV cleanup and reconciliation; not an AI-system benchmark
important_limits: These are advertised prices, not accepted quotes or verified payments.

Human service providers commonly use Excel, Power Query or Python. No-AI delivery is unverified except where a service specifically limits external AI data processing; that still does not prove no AI-assisted development.
Upwork listing detail was available through public search indexing, while direct page fetch returned HTTP 403. No signed-in access, outreach or booking was performed.
Currency is USD for Upwork prices based on the platform's official support page. Tax, FX and marketplace client charges may add to the displayed service fee.
A single listing cannot establish a market-wide representative price or competent quality; use a declared matched listing as a reference and retain lower-price sensitivity.

currency_source.fact: Upwork states all listed costs are in USD; local-currency billing can use conversion rates that vary by billing time.

recommended_freeze.package: One UTF-8 public or synthetic CSV, declared rulebook, output/duplicates/exceptions/report, original preserved, one correction round within scope
recommended_freeze.panel_interpretation: Designed three-point observed advertised-service-price sensitivity, not quantiles or a representative market distribution. 20 captures Patrick low anchor; 49 captures small matched package; 99 is richer 501-10000-row package reference. Report all cells and scope gaps, not only favorable cells.
recommended_freeze.human_service_scope_requirement: Check review/revision/support/evidence equivalence separately for each anchor. Never infer professional competence merely from a posted price.
recommended_freeze.do_not_claim: Market average, observed willingness to pay, observed demand probability, certified equivalence, or superiority to all providers
